## Fixed

- **Sending a message failed with a refusal** ("not available on your account") even though the website and the official app worked. Janitor's firewall had started turning away Butler's send request. Butler now sends it the way the website does, so messages go through again. It also stopped sending every saved proxy key with each message: only the one you're using goes out now.
- **Personas.** Replies kept treating you as your default persona, whichever one you picked. Now the persona you're playing is the one the character sees, and switching persona mid-chat works too: the new one takes over, and your earlier lines stay with the persona that wrote them.

## New

- **Pronoun macros.** `{{sub}}`, `{{obj}}`, `{{poss}}`, `{{poss_p}}` and `{{ref}}` now fill in from your persona's pronouns, like `{{user}}` does with its name (they/them when a persona has none set).
- **Images in chat.** Markdown pictures (`![alt](url)`) now show in messages. Images hosted by Janitor load right away. Images from anywhere else wait for you to tap **Load image**, because loading one shows that site your IP address.
- **More room to type.** The keys in the message box are smaller, giving your words more of the width.

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.2.3.apk** below. It installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings.
